statement: Principal Gysin images lie in the ordinary closed-restriction kernel integrally; explicit infinite-order kernels for r>=2,r+1<=N<=2r-1
depends_on: Stacks02T8/0B6Z/0B3P; C.3t explicit nonzero Gysin classes; dimension vanishing
